Read a ticket with ticket-read before you talk about it.

## Changing tickets
- ticket-comment-add adds a comment.
  Keep it short.
- ticket-archive archives a ticket.

## Finding tickets
- ticket-read reads one; ticket-comment-add is for after.
- Say the title, not the id.
